line: Lovely shop you've got. Be a shame if the windows kept going in.
Keep your mouth shut or else.
You didn't see anything. Did you. Because people who see things get hurt.
Say a word and you'll regret it.
Not a word to Rita, if you know what's good for you.
Talk to the police and I'll make sure you never work on this street again.
Grass on me and your lease won't be worth the paper.
I'd think very carefully before you open your mouth, love. Very carefully.
You've got a nice quiet life. Keep it that way. Forget what you saw.
One word from you and I'll know it was you. Remember that.
If Ellis hears about this, I'll be round to see you. Nobody else.
Accidents happen round here. Especially to people with loose tongues.
Forget last night, Darren, or you'll be walking with a limp.
I know where you drink your tea every morning. Keep that in mind before you talk.
Breathe a word and you're finished on this street.
Be a shame if the council heard about your back room, wouldn't it? So we'll both keep quiet.
You'll keep it to yourself, or I'll tell everyone what I know about you.
Tell anyone and I'll burn the place down.
Don't make me come back here about this.
Keep schtum. I won't ask twice.
Please don't tell anyone. I'm begging you.
Could you keep this between us? I'd be grateful.
Keep it to yourself, eh? For Mickey's sake.
I know where you live, you daft sod, I've been round for tea twice.
I'll see you right if you keep it quiet. A bit extra this week.
Say a word and you'll regret it, ha! Only joking, love.
"Say a word and you'll regret it," that's what he told me.
If you tell the police they'll want a statement, and that's your whole afternoon gone.
Be careful who you talk to about it. There's people round here who wouldn't like it.
What did you see last night?
You'd tell me if you saw anything, wouldn't you?
I'm sorry about the window. It was me. I'll pay for it.
Don't worry, I won't tell anyone either.
Mickey used to say loose lips sink ships.
Keep an eye on the shop for me while I'm out.
I'd rather you didn't mention it to Sheila yet. I'll tell her myself.
If anyone asks, just say you don't know. It's easier for everyone.
Right, I'll leave you to it. See you tomorrow.
You look worried. Is something wrong?
People get hurt on that quay, you know. Mind the edge.
